# GroupDocs.Total documentation

Hugo sources for https://docs.groupdocs.com/total/.

Platform folders: net, java, nodejs-java, python-net. Do not delete them.

Java package: com.groupdocs:groupdocs-total
Maven repository: https://releases.groupdocs.com/java/repo/
Java docs: https://docs.groupdocs.com/total/java/

Start here for Java:

- java/_index.md
- java/getting-started/installation.md
- java/getting-started/supported-document-formats.md
- java/getting-started/sdk-cloud-mcp.md

Python package: groupdocs-total-net on PyPI, a metapackage that installs the 14 GroupDocs for Python via .NET products
Python docs: https://docs.groupdocs.com/total/python-net/

Start here for Python:

- python-net/_index.md
- python-net/getting-started/installation.md
- python-net/getting-started/quick-start-guide.md

Build: build_docs.cmd or bash build_docs.sh. See CLAUDE.md.
Product page: https://products.groupdocs.com/total/
Java examples: https://github.com/groupdocs-total/GroupDocs.Total-for-Java
Python examples: https://github.com/groupdocs-total/GroupDocs.Total-for-Python-via-.NET
MCP (link only): https://github.com/groupdocs-total/GroupDocs.Total.Mcp

Do not invent a format count.
